issues.on_page: County receipts 18,311.55 (= General Fund 2110 County fines and license fees, p8)
issues.issue: The whole line is code 2110 county fines and license fees. The extractor rules say code 2110 is 'fines and forfeitures', not state aid.
Code 2110 should be category 'fines and forfeitures' with detail_category 'fines and forfeitures'.
